name: deadline-center-edimension-companion
description: Chrome/Edge extension to extract and organize deadlines from eDimension

scripts.build: tsc && vite build && esbuild src/content/content-unified.ts --bundle --format=iife --outfile=dist/content.js --target=es2020 && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const content = fs.readFileSync('dist/content.js', 'utf8'); const hasImport = /^\s*(import|export)\s/m.test(content); if (hasImport) { console.error('ERROR: content.js still contains import/export statements!'); process.exit(1); } else { console.log('✓ content.js is a valid IIFE with no imports'); }"
